confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from crowdsourced aggregator pages (Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere, GlobalCostData, TravelTables, Livingcost) that disagree and are partly dated (some from 2023 to 2025), so restaurant and drink values are bounded estimates. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. Wine glass is inferred from the local beer price, roughly 1.4 times beer. Cocktail and beer use aggregator points, not a city-wide survey. EUR prices were converted to USD at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR because no EUR rate was retrieved. The FX observation below is a 3 November 2026 4pm reference reported by a secondary market update and attributed to the RBA; I could not confirm it against the RBA's F11.1 table, and no later observation was found, so it may not be the latest available.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used for the anchors. Food and drink are based on Bratislava-specific aggregator data, with local beer used as the reference for the wine glass. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for a mid-sized Central European capital in peak summer, not derived from a comparable city's data.
